ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution across the fluke surface with a low contrast ratio; approximately 90% of the surface pixels are in the low-intensity range, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized superficial marks and distal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous mass across both lobes. High-contrast white geometric blobs are localized at the distal lateral tips (barnacle clusters) and as dispersed focal points and lines on the interior surface of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 110-120 degrees at the vertex of the lobe separation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular sawtooth topography along the continuous trailing edge, with pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) ranging from 3 to 10 pixels across the boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic curves extending from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel high-intensity (white) linear streaks detected on the left lobe, ranging from 10 to 40 pixels in length, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentations (nicks) along the trailing edge and heavy barnacle colonization at the distal lateral edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, isolated high-intensity circular spots located in the lower-central region of the left fluke lobe.
